newsitem.title: USA: D&P lowers Liberty unit's rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P lowers Liberty unit's rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it lowered the claims-paying rating of Liberty Life Insurance Co, a unit of Liberty Corp, to Double A Minus from Double A.

The rating action is based on challenges Liberty faces in growing sales and profitability of its core agency life insurance business, Duff & Phelps said. The rating, which remains in the very-high category, continues to reflect Liberty Life's franchise value in its agency and mortgage protection businesses, strong capital position and high quality investment portfolio.
